raw_task: How should compass persist and surface branch-comparison results to the user?

branches.name: Inline guard-only summary
branches.description: Keep compass-explore-branches exactly as it is today: print the scores table in chat and rely on the guard's JSON output. No new files, no new script, no HTML report -- the fastest to ship and the least that could possibly work.
branches.biggest_blocker: Loses the report entirely for anyone who reruns compass-solve later and wants to see how a decision was actually reached.

branches.name: Standalone D3 branch-comparison viewer
branches.description: Add a build_branch_comparison_html.py that renders state.json's Explore branches as a small-multiples grouped-bar D3 chart, built against the shared tokens.css/inline-d3.html vendored in the report-viewer foundation PR, and wire it into compass-explore-branches's Persist step so every run produces a report by default.
branches.biggest_blocker: Requires fixing the Persist step's structural gap (currently nested only under the Manual path, so the preferred Workflow path never persists state.json at all).

branches.name: Radar chart for N-axis comparison
branches.description: Render the Feasibility/Impact/Risk/Total comparison as a radar/spider chart, one polygon per branch overlaid on shared axes -- the default choice for multi-axis comparisons in most charting libraries.
branches.biggest_blocker: cupertino-council already rejected this mark type for this exact data shape: enclosed polygon area is not proportional to score in any way a viewer can correctly decode, and overlapping polygons obscure the tie-break-by-risk signal.

branches.name: Defer to a future cross-plugin dashboard
branches.description: Do not build a compass-specific viewer at all; wait for a hypothetical unified werkstoff dashboard that would show every plugin's reports in one place, and skip this feature until that exists.
branches.biggest_blocker: No such dashboard is planned or scoped anywhere in this repo -- this branch defers indefinitely to something that does not exist.
